target_customer: Consumers who use multiple AI assistants, plus apps that integrate Sign in with AI Passport
problem: Each AI assistant builds its own siloed memory of the user. AI Passport is a user-owned portable context profile with permissioned, revocable access for apps.
business_model: Consumer product plus B2B2C integrations; Domovoy hardware planned at a $199 reservation and $2,999 starting price
product_category: Personal context and memory layer, with planned local hardware

founders.name: Erin McGurk
education: University of Cambridge, BA in Land Economy
founders.background_notes: YC bio says she grew a social following from 0 to 1M+ in a year and advised Cambridge and the UK Government on social media strategy.

founders.name: David Khachaturov
education: University of Cambridge, BA/MA and PhD in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: Youngest-ever Fellow at St Catharine's College, Cambridge per YC bio.

competitors.name: Mem0 OpenMemory
competitors.what: Browser extension and memory layer working across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini

competitors.name: Google Gemini memory import
competitors.what: Settings tools to import memory and chat history from other AI apps

competitors.name: Era Context and CORE
competitors.what: MCP-based portable memory and an open memory standard effort

technical_complexity.rationale: Connectors for about 800 apps and a custom retrieval layer are standard engineering; local hardware assistant adds a harder stage.

defensibility.rationale: Platforms have added memory import, and several startups sell portable memory; value depends on app integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Gemini added memory import in 2026 and other assistants added memory features; fate for Egoist unknown.

market_need_then: Commentary in 2026 describes memory locked inside each assistant and calls for portability; the company reported 41 percent week-over-week waitlist growth and over 10 B2B2C pilots in its launch release.

identity.mascot_or_character: Domovoy, the household spirit of Russian folklore, as the name of the planned hardware (link to company not confirmed by sources)
identity.visual_style: Passport card metaphor with First Edition passport cards
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct second person, privacy focused: You protect your money. It's time to protect your data.

branding.brand_signature: AI Passport and Sign in with AI Passport
branding.community_and_virality: Launch covered by several newsletters and funding outlets in October 2026.

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent passport metaphor and distinctive company name with launch coverage in several outlets; name connotes selfishness.

outcome_analysis: Egoist Machines is an Active Summer 2026 company that announced a $3M seed round and public launch of AI Passport in October 2026. Founders have Cambridge, OpenAI and security backgrounds. The risk is platform capture, since assistants are adding their own memory and import tools.
notes: Seed confirmed by Pulse 2, Dealroom news and SignalBase, all launch-period coverage; investors are YC and Goodwater, with other backers reported without names. Dealroom company profile separately shows $125k, which is likely the YC deal. Nordic9 lists a Cambridge office. No explanation of the name found. Founded year not found.
